answer: Each identity posts 500 POA keyed to a hardware root, so one secure element backs one account. Every submission carries a fresh nonce and goes to a second panel, adding 2 graders and 1 replay check per claim. A farm of 1,000 clones needs 1,000 secure elements and 500,000 POA locked. One reused nonce voids the ripple of pending rewards, and the trellis of bonds collapses before a comet of volume pays out.
